description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerDao class, which provides database access and operations for PerformanceTracker entities within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and querying performance trackers and their related reviewers, leveraging Doctrine ORM and custom query builders.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDao
classes.description: Data access object responsible for performing CRUD operations and complex queries related to PerformanceTracker entities, including handling reviewers, status updates, and search functionalities within the HRM system.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTracker entity by its ID if it exists and is active.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing PerformanceTracker IDs from a given list of IDs, filtering out deleted ones.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackList
methods.description: Fetches a list of PerformanceTrackers based on specified search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of PerformanceTrackers matching the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: savePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTracker and associated reviewers within a transaction, ensuring data integrity.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerReviewers
methods.description: Creates and saves reviewer associations for a specific PerformanceTracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query with filters and sorting for retrieving PerformanceTrackers based on search parameters.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Marks specified PerformanceTrackers as deleted by updating their status.

methods.name: getReviewerListByTrackerId
methods.description: Fetches all reviewer associations for a given PerformanceTracker ID.

methods.name: updatePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Updates a PerformanceTracker and its reviewers, handling additions and deletions as necessary.

methods.name: deleteExistingReviewers
methods.description: Removes reviewer associations for a PerformanceTracker based on reviewer IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee-specific PerformanceTrackers based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerCount
methods.description: Counts PerformanceTrackers based on employee-specific search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder for employee-specific PerformanceTracker retrieval with applied filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all PerformanceTracker IDs available.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Fetches PerformanceTracker IDs where a specific employee is a reviewer.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches PerformanceTracker IDs associated with a specific employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs that are reviewed by a specific reviewer.

methods.name: isTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number is assigned as a reviewer in any active PerformanceTracker.

methods.name: isTrackerOwnerEditable
methods.description: Determines if a PerformanceTracker can be edited based on the existence of non-deleted log entries.
